blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Reviewed 2026-11-27 at HyperEVM blocks 52378604 and 52378877. Delpho USDV (0x8c6eb3c8d1fddc752684274fb4a3eb98dbe9cd26) is an EIP-1967 UUPS proxy pointing to verified implementation 0xb4616e1814c74f9528aadddc23d45780fa453ccb. Standard ERC-20 transfers are not directly pausable or blacklistable in the current implementation; setPaused() gates only mint() and burn(). However, the V1 admin Safe (0x590fec6d69508da8498f10d3401ffc0b538fae09, Gnosis Safe 1.4.1, 3-of-4, zero modules, zero guard) can upgrade the token implementation without a timelock or grant MINTER_ROLE to an operator that invokes burn(from, amount) without holder allowance. In addition, 72.8% of measured collateral is freezable upstream stablecoins (72.7% USDC and 0.1% USDT0). Under Pharos's taxonomy, both the no-delay upgrade/role-grant surface and >50% freezable upstream collateral resolve to Possible, not Yes.

oracleRisk.summary: Delpho USDV values all four collateral assets across its isolated Stablecoin and HYPE/kHYPE markets via dedicated HyperEVM Chainlink AggregatorV3 feeds (24-hour heartbeat, 0.5% deviation). Strict staleness checks block vault mints, withdrawals, and PSM operations when feeds go stale, while vault redemptions and permissionless liquidations intentionally remain executable on stale answers.

branchApplicability.rationale: Delpho maintains four distinct collateral assets across two isolated CDP markets (USDC and USDT0 in the Stablecoin market with 95% max LTV / 97% liquidation threshold; kHYPE and WHYPE in the HYPE/kHYPE market with 65% max LTV / 80% liquidation threshold), each wired to its own HyperEVM Chainlink feed and per-collateral supply cap. Each collateral branch therefore requires its own oracle and liquidation evidence row.

branches.label: USDC collateral branch (Stablecoin Market + PSM)
branches.summary: Stablecoin Market DelphoOracle (0x87c56286) reads HyperEVM Chainlink USDC/USD (capped at $1.00, 86,460s staleness window) to value USDC in both the Stablecoin Vault and DelphoPSM.

feeds.path: Chainlink USDC/USD (8 dec, 24h heartbeat, 0.5% dev) -> Stablecoin DelphoOracle (0x87c56286, maxPrice=$1.00) -> Stablecoin Vault and DelphoPSM

branches.fallbackBehavior: Strict staleness check (86,460s) reverts vault mints, collateral withdrawals, and PSM mint/redeem calls on stale or invalid prices. Vault redemptions and liquidations intentionally skip staleness checks per Sherlock audit recommendations so deleveraging remains executable during feed delays.

collateralParameters.note: 95% max LTV, 97% liquidation threshold, 10,000,000 USDC supply cap, 0% borrow APR, up to 10% liquidation penalty, 1% caller reward capped at $50; parameters adjustable without delay by the 3-of-4 V1 admin Safe.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Permissionless liquidation triggers immediately when a borrower's LTV exceeds the 97% liquidation threshold. The Stablecoin Market Stability Pool absorbs bad positions first; uncovered debt and collateral redistribute equally across up to 50 solvent borrowers in the same market.
branches.backstop: Stablecoin Market Stability Pool (0x3bd10d1f0eac488bf26ab36c84fba434ccf7db5e, protocol-owned treasury sUSDV; observed 0 USDV / 0 sUSDV on-chain balance at block 52378804) followed by equal-share redistribution across up to 50 solvent borrowers in the Stablecoin market.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: No automated global shutdown; the 3-of-4 V1 admin Safe can pause protocol operations via emergency carve-outs. Residual bad debt exceeding Stability Pool capacity is socialized across up to 50 active borrowers in the same market, with a ~5% TVL treasury reserve target as secondary protocol buffer.
